summary: Tested Consenso Privacy fix (searchable text field replacing dropdown) on /servizio → tab Privacy. Found and fixed a critical missing import (`Input` component) that made the whole PrivacyTab throw a runtime ReferenceError and blank out the tab. After fix all scenarios pass: suggestion 'Getili Francesco' appears exactly once when typing 'get', clicking populates the input, PDF preview opens and renders a 1-page canvas. Free-text 'Mario Prova Libero' works. Empty-name PDF returns 200 / 1 page. Regression on Dati bancari tab OK (iban-abi visible, btn-pdf-coordinate clickable). Backend /api/servizio/privacy.pdf verified with pypdf: contains the provided name and is exactly 1 page in all three cases; unauthenticated returns 401.

ui_bugs.issue: `Input` used without import → ReferenceError: Input is not defined, entire tab crashed via ErrorBoundary. Fixed by adding `import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';`

issues: Client 'Getili Francesco' shows extra='Barxca' (likely typo in tipo_barca of the client record - not a code bug, data issue)

critical_code_review_comments: PrivacyTab.jsx was missing the Input import — indicates the component was not smoke-tested by the implementer after the dropdown→text-field refactor. Suggest adding a build-time check or ESLint 'no-undef' enforcement (currently only warnings level).
Suggestion dropdown uses `s.key` (client id) which can collide between /clienti and /esterni if a rare id clash occurred; consider prefixing keys ('c-{id}' / 'e-{id}') for safety.
privacy_pdf endpoint correctly accepts free-form `nome` and sanitises via .strip(); no injection concerns since name is only rendered in PDF text.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PrivacyTab now has Input imported. All privacy PDF scenarios verified end-to-end (UI + backend PDF text extraction with pypdf). Reusable pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_privacy_pdf.py.
rca of the issue: Root cause: When refactoring the client field from Select dropdown to a searchable <Input>, the implementer added `<Input>` JSX but forgot to add the import. Because ESLint is at warning level (`react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` etc.) the build succeeded but React threw ReferenceError at render time inside PrivacyTab, so the tab body was replaced by the ErrorBoundary/RUE overlay. Reproduction: navigate /servizio → click Consenso privacy tab → runtime error. Mitigation applied: added `import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';` in PrivacyTab.jsx.
